info.name: AAFM Dashboard API (Tiers 1-3 + features)
info.description:
Multi-tenant analytics dashboard API: Org → Team hierarchy, RLS isolation, server-side sessions; Tier 2 adds active users, KPIs (ARPU, CTR, error rate) and anomaly alerts; Tier 3 adds projects (Org → Team → Project), custom metric formulas, the audit log and signed webhooks; folder 10 covers notifications, audit search, chat-app webhooks, shared-data requests and completed projects. Real-time (Socket.IO) and webhook delivery to a live receiver are covered by backend/test/realtime.test.js, tier2.test.js and tier3.test.js, since Postman collections cannot drive Socket.IO.

**Setup**
1. `npm run migrate && npm run seed && npm run dev` in `backend/`.
2. The suite signs in ~13 times; the default auth rate limit is 10 per 15 min per IP, so set `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=100` in `backend/.env` for local runs.
3. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner (folders build on each other's saved variables).

**How auth works here**: the session is an HttpOnly cookie that Postman's cookie jar keeps automatically. Each `Sign in` request switches the active user. Every write sends `X-Requested-With` (CSRF guard); requests in `09 Security checks` omit it on purpose.

Seed users (org `acme`, password `Password@123`): super@ (Super Admin), alice@ (Finance admin + Marketing viewer), bob@ (Finance editor), carol@ (Marketing viewer), dave@ (Marketing admin).
